responsibility: Provides IBM RS/6000 and PowerPC common hooks for GCC’s shared option machinery, combining architecture-specific optimization defaults, option-structure initialization, parsing of many TOC, ABI, debug, relocatability, reciprocal-math, and long-double switches, and split-stack capability reporting. It establishes policy defaults like section anchors and asynchronous unwind tables, updates rs6000 ISA flag fields and related option state in response to target switches, and supplies the common targetm_common interface used across the rs6000 backend family.
